content: {"rule":"K-S2","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge assigns UNDERDETERMINED after noting the virgin/young-woman wording and the prophetic application were answered, which treats the verse's multiple senses as leaving the point open.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].","rule_words":"That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.","room":"The phrase 'A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.' I weighed reading it as barring UNDERDETERMINED when a verse is treated as open because both senses were addressed, versus reading it as only barring an explicit 'single verse does not state it' rationale; the judge's reason relies on the verse's two answered aspects.","why":"By making UNDERDETERMINED rest on the answered virgin/young-woman wording and answered prophetic application, the judge treats a verse with two senses as open, contrary to K-S2's requirement that both senses stand."}
